clusters.headline: European Leaders Seek Influence Over Upcoming Ukraine Peace Talks
aiSummaryBullets: European officials express concerns regarding the potential for Ukraine to be pressured into accepting unfavorable peace terms.
Internal political scrutiny over the financial costs of military assistance is increasing within several European nations.

clusters.headline: Russia Launches Large-Scale Airstrikes Against Ukrainian Energy Grid
aiSummaryBullets: Russian forces deployed over 170 drones and 36 missiles in attacks across the Kyiv region.
The strikes targeted key electricity infrastructure and a bridge spanning the Dnipro River.
